layers.name: Agent Skills & Development Lifecycle
layers.description: Engineering workflows, specialist review personas, and automated slash commands in .agents/, agents/, and commands/.

layers.name: Architecture Documentation & Standards
layers.description: System documentation, standing checklists in references/, audits in local/, and architectural Markdown specifications.

layers.name: Local Tooling, Scripts & Postman
layers.description: Postman API collections, local database migration scripts, and dev utilities.

layers.name: Frontend Presentation & UI
layers.description: Next.js App router pages, Terminal Editorial feature views, widgets, and shadcn/ui components.

layers.name: Frontend Services & Client State
layers.description: TanStack Query custom hooks, API clients, auth context, and client formatters.

layers.name: REST API Controllers & Endpoints
layers.description: Spring Boot REST controllers and Next.js route handlers exposing portfolio and financial endpoints.

layers.name: Domain & Calculation Services
layers.description: Core financial calculation engines (32 calculators), SIP scheduling, valuation, and business workflows.

layers.name: Hexagonal Broker Adapters
layers.description: Zerodha Kite, Upstox, and Angel One adapter implementations, normalization mappers, and session management.

layers.name: Security & Access Control
layers.description: Spring Security configurations, JWT token filters, TOTP 2FA verification, and rate limiting.

layers.name: Persistence & Domain Models
layers.description: Spring Data JPA repositories, Hibernate entity definitions, SQL migrations, and DTO contracts.

layers.name: Infrastructure, DevOps & Tooling
layers.description: Docker orchestration, Maven and Node package configs, Tailwind design tokens, and test suites.

tour.title: Project Overview & Architecture
tour.description: Understand CoinTrack's multi-asset wealth management architecture, Docker containerization, and engineering design system.

tour.title: Agent Skills & Quality Standards
tour.description: Explore the packaged agent skills in .agents/skills/, specialist review personas, and standing engineering checklists.

tour.title: Application Bootstrapping & Security Entry Points
tour.description: Explore Spring Boot application bootstrap, SecurityFilterChain definitions, JWT filter interception, and TOTP 2FA verification.

tour.title: Multi-Broker Hexagonal Architecture
tour.description: Examine how CoinTrack abstracts Zerodha Kite, Upstox, and Angel One brokers via hexagonal adapter ports, credential token encryption, and canonical data normalization.

tour.title: Stock Portfolio & Equity Valuation
tour.description: Trace how stock holdings are tracked, trade records are managed, and real-time P&L analytics are computed.

tour.title: Mutual Funds, SIP & AMFI NAV Engine
tour.description: Learn how mutual fund schemes are managed, daily AMFI NAVs are automatically synchronized, and SIP lumpsum transactions are recorded.

tour.title: Financial Calculators & Fixed Income (FD, EPF, PPF, Gold & Silver)
tour.description: Discover CoinTrack's 32 calculation engines (loans, investments, taxes) and multi-asset tracking for Fixed Deposits, EPF, PPF, and Gold/Silver bullion.

tour.title: Next.js Frontend & Terminal Editorial UI
tour.description: Inspect the Next.js App Router presentation layer, featuring the Terminal Editorial aesthetic, TanStack Query data synchronization, and dashboard layouts.
